title: Egg Counter Sensor Miss Rate
dataSources: Hive metrics (`flowhive:reading`), egg counter events (`eggcounter:event`), goat RFID visits (`goattag:scan`), goat watering and feed logs (`goatcare:event`), and compost readings (`compost:reading`).
app: Smallholding and backyard telemetry from Flow Hive scales, chicken coop counters, RFID goat tags, compost thermometers, and camera-driven chore logs sent to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=eggcounter:event
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as attempts count(eval(verified="true")) as successful by _time sensor_id
| eval success_pct=if(attempts>0,round(100*successful/attempts,1),0)
| sort - _time
description: Tracks success rate for egg counter detections by sensor.
value: Verification rate tells you whether the coop counter is trustworthy enough to automate around.
implementation: Capture explicit outcome states for egg counter detections events in `index=personal` and review both attempts and success percentage over time.
visualization: Time chart of success percentage for egg counter detections by sensor.
grandmaExplanation: It blends how often egg counter detections works the way you expect instead of quietly failing.
